text.text: The truck's whole business in one page: service stops with sales, permits that must never lapse, the commissary prep list for each stop and private booking requests. Check the Dashboard before every service, load the truck from the prep list and look at permits expiring in the next 30 days every Monday.

How to read the numbers

cells.text: Sales minus the fee paid for the spot
Compare by kind of stop to find the best places to be
The sales we hoped for at the stop
A stop under target three times in a row gets dropped
Start renewals at 45 days; negative means stop serving until renewed
Prep items loaded for the stop
All loaded before the truck leaves the commissary

text.text: The night before
Prep list read and divided between cooks
Propane, water and ice checked
Cash float and card reader charged
Morning at the commissary
Cook and cool items in the order on the prep list.
Label every container with the item, date and time.
Load the truck coldest and heaviest first; press Load it as items go on.
Before leaving
Check the truck lights, tires and fire extinguisher.
Confirm the stop address and arrival time with the contact.
The best stop in the world fails if the truck leaves without the tortillas.
What to compare

cells.text: How many people walk past during our hours?
Who else sells similar food nearby?
Is vending allowed, and for how long?

text.text: Learning from results
After each stop, enter sales and hours.
Compare Sales after spot fee by kind of stop each month.
Keep the top three places, test one new place a week, and drop what misses its target.
The calendar
Every permit sits in the Permits table with an expiry date.
On the first of each month, open Permits expiring in 45 days.
Renewing
Start at 45 days; gather the forms and the fee.
Send the application and note the date.
When the new document arrives, press Renewed and update the dates.
Never
Serve with an expired permit or insurance. One inspection can cost a season.
At the stop
Count the cash, run the card report and note what sold out.
Wipe down surfaces, empty grease and greywater into approved containers.
Back at the commissary
Unload leftovers and log what must be thrown away.
Clean the truck, restock cups and napkins.
Enter sales and hours on the stop and press Close out the day.
The next morning
Read the notes from the last stop before writing the prep list.
